page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 32 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier for its hardware class. It achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1573.69 and a multi-core score of 33210.62. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1856.24 GB/sec, which drops to 111.56 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 52.56 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the server demonstrates strong processing capabilities, yielding a Geekbench multi-core score of 11417.0, a Passmark database operations score of 12087.98, and a Redis SET throughput of 30.49 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.3 GHz offer reliable compute density without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external storage provisioning. This hardware profile is well-suited for workloads such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
